verdict.rationale: Name.com's Core API covers much of what the UI does: availability checks for up to 50 names, registration, transfers, DNS records, email forwarding, WHOIS privacy, domain settings (locks, autorenew, contacts), renewals, TLD pricing and webhook subscriptions. However, nothing documents full UI parity, and API tokens must be issued through the web UI's Account Settings. UI features such as browsing expiring domains and premium names have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API support for credential management, API coverage of expiring/premium domain browsing, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
